mesh_split_long_edges — 3D resolution op

• 数据种类:mesh → mesh

• 调用:import meshres; meshres.mesh_split_long_edges(V, F, max_edge, max_passes=20)(或 ops3d.get("mesh_split_long_edges"))

用法

> 该算子的说明尚无译文,以下照原文给出。

Bisect edges longer than *max_edge* until none remains — adaptive refinement (`mesh`).
